response.courseDescription: 304 Ecosystem Field Measurements Measurement and analysis of forests, wildlife habitat, and rangelands using field equipment and spatial sampling techniques; development of employment skills in forestry, forest restoration, and wildlife management. Cooperative: Open to UI degree-seeking students.
response.coursePrerequisites: SOE 204; SOE 300 or BIOLOGY 372 or concurrent enrollment in either; SOE 301 or concurrent enrollment.
